verdict_reason: Mandatory Stop Gate triggered during dependency resolution dry run. Pinned dependency langchain==0.3.7 requires numpy<2 on Python 3.11, which conflicts with protected package shap==0.51.0 (requires numpy>=2) and tensorflow==2.21.0 subdependency ml_dtypes==0.6.0 (requires numpy>=2.0.0). Installation was safely halted without modifying host environment.

impacted_protected_packages.impact: Violated if numpy is downgraded to 1.26.4; pip check fails. Alternatively downgraded to 0.49.1.
Violated if numpy is downgraded to 1.26.4; breaks tensorflow internal float types.

stop_gate_reasons: Downgrade of numpy would break protected package shap==0.51.0 and tensorflow subdependency ml_dtypes==0.6.0
Dependency resolution produces conflicts with existing ML environment
Mandatory stop gate rule requires halting before installation

recommendations.recommended_solution: Alternative 1: Install langgraph==0.2.45 and langchain-core==0.3.15 strictly, omitting langchain==0.3.7.

alternatives.name: Alternative 1 (Recommended)
alternatives.action: Modify backend/requirements-phase5.txt to include only langgraph==0.2.45 and langchain-core==0.3.15.
alternatives.rationale: LangGraph multi-agent orchestration (StateGraph, Command, Send, TypedDict state) and tool adapters depend strictly on langgraph and langchain-core. The monolithic langchain package is not required. langgraph and langchain-core have zero numpy dependencies, leaving numpy==2.4.6, shap==0.51.0, and tensorflow==2.21.0 100% clean and compatible.

alternatives.name: Alternative 2
alternatives.action: Upgrade langchain to 0.3.20+ and langchain-core to 0.3.41.
alternatives.rationale: LangChain dropped the numpy<2 constraint in version 0.3.20. Compatible with numpy 2.x, but requires bumping langchain-core beyond 0.3.15.

alternatives.name: Alternative 3
alternatives.action: Downgrade numpy to 1.26.4, shap to 0.49.1, and ml_dtypes to <0.6.0.
alternatives.rationale: Allows langchain==0.3.7 but mutates protected ML packages. High regression risk.
